notes: This is an exhaustive normalized list of candidate feature stores declared by S223-S231. Base corpora, labels, and market inputs are not candidate feature stores. A store is GLOB-REACHABLE only when its exact declared path matches catalogue.GLOBS. NEEDS-ONE-NAMED-LINE means a dated parquet at or above the declared row floor that would otherwise be usable. NOT-ENUMERABLE records JSON-only, snapshot-only, undated, or unresolved logical sources without substituting another path.
